title: NEXORA Connector event registry
description: The closed set of asynchronous events the Connector may emit (protocol frame type 'event'). An event type not listed here is a protocol error, which keeps UI code from binding to an event that only exists on one build. Payloads are secret-free by construction: each payload schema sets additionalProperties:false and carries ids plus immutable facts (docs/architecture/36).

protocolVersion.description: Protocol major this build registers events for; a client reads it from connector.hello, not from this field.

events.description: Names registered for a given connector build; must be a subset of the catalog below.

catalog.description: Payload schema per event name. Referenced by protocol/commands/connector.events.subscribe.json.

retained.description: Retained events are re-sent to a subscriber that connects after the fact, because a service worker can be torn down between the event and the UI that must show it.

traceId.description: Correlation id. Pattern excludes '.', ':' and any character that appears in hostnames, URLs or credentials, so a trace id cannot smuggle a secret into a log line (docs/architecture/25 non-goal).
